# Plan a Small Event with AI

Use AI to compare small-event plans, confirm responsibilities and revise the details when circumstances change.

[Start this course on AILesson](https://ailesson.io/courses/plan-a-small-event-with-ai)

A small gathering can involve surprisingly many linked decisions. A cheap room may miss someone's access needs, a helpful volunteer may be unavailable for cleanup, and changing the venue can leave an old location in the invitation.

You will plan a neighborhood games afternoon from supplied participant needs, venue options and replies. AI helps organize the information, compare workable plans and update related drafts. You decide what matters, ask the questions that could change your choice, check what people have actually agreed to, and inspect the revision when the first room becomes unavailable.

The four Lessons build one continuous plan. You begin with a short planning brief, compare venues and materials, prepare responsibilities and an invitation, then revise the plan after a supplied change. The method also applies to a reading group, a volunteer afternoon or a family gathering: give AI the relevant facts, make your decision rules visible, and check every affected part when those facts change.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do I need event-planning experience or a connected calendar?

No. The Course supplies the facts and recorded AI exchanges. You do not need to connect accounts, contact a venue or run a separate AI chat to follow the Lessons. Ordinary text chat is enough if you later try the method yourself.

### Can I use the method for my own gathering?

Yes. Replace the practice materials with information you are allowed to share, including actual availability, access needs and current costs. These practice people, venues and replies are invented for learning; their details are not real offers.

### Will I finish with a booked event and a sent invitation?

You finish with a checked practice plan and an unsent invitation draft. The organizer still needs to confirm the booking, add verified arrival details and send the reviewed message. The Course teaches how to prepare and check that work.
